evidence_layer: synthetic memory oracle: original ARM bytes executed in Unicorn over a staged 32-byte-node Json tree and a bump heap; NOT device execution

trees.main: skeleton(meta) + 3 bones + slot(blend/color/attachment) + ik + transform + path + skin(region+mesh) + event + animation(rotate 3 frames curve+stepped, translate 2 frames, event frame)
trees.err_parent: main with bone arm parent=forearm (Parent bone not found)
trees.perturb: main with the last translate frame removed and the animation renamed walk2

input_domain.note: This is the contract input set only; it is not the full input domain and not device equivalence.

comparable_fields.spSkeletonData: 21 words: strings/counts/floats exact; pointer words compared as non-null presence plus their per-element records (heap addresses differ by construction)
per_element: ik/transform/path names, bone lists, targets, scalars
skin name/entries; attachment type/name/path plus region or mesh payload
animation name/duration/timelineCount; per timeline type/frameCount/ffc/index/frame bits/curve bits/event frames
not_comparable: creator internal layout beyond the fields above

dump_protocol.payload: 21 u32 words, spine str, hash str

field_table.note: Every field row carries original/rebuild values, equal flag and segment attribution; main_s2p0 is the contract run.
